items.title: ISIS-linked women willing to take the 'hit' of arrests for their kids' freedom
items.description: When a group of so-called "ISIS brides" boarded a flight from Doha to Melbourne, they took a leap of faith, unsure of what fate awaited them at the end of their journey. But they said they were willing to face arrest for the freedom of their children.

items.title: Australia on cusp of housing downturn as demand softens
items.description: The tight supply conditions that have underpinned the national housing market in recent years are starting to ease, according to property data firm Cotality.

items.title: What the tax reform duo could mean for renters
items.description: With changes to negative gearing and capital gains tax coming in this year's federal budget, we spoke to three experts who explained how this will impact rental prices.

items.title: Entrepreneurs warn against reducing CGT discount on shares
items.description: Some entrepreneurs argue any changes to reduce the capital gains tax discount should carve out the start-up sector. However,  tax experts warn this would create too much complexity in an already complicated tax system.

items.title: Trump wanted an American pope but not this American pope
items.description: Foreign leaders and lobbyists thought they would write the next chapter in Catholic history. They failed and Leo is proving to be the pope that some of them feared.

items.title: Rubio visits the Vatican after Trump's attacks on Pope Leo XIV
items.description: The secretary of state was seeking to mend fences after US President Donald Trump's social media broadsides against the pope for his opposition to the Iran war.

items.title: High-profile witness opens up on 'fashionable' rise of antisemitism
items.description: A high-profile witness tells a royal commission that antisemitism is a "virus" which has evolved over time, with aggressors on the far right and far left side of politics.

items.title: 'We come together in unity': Nationwide vigils held for Kumanjayi Little Baby
items.description: Vigils have been held across the country in memory of five-year-old Kumanjayi Little Baby, who was allegedly murdered in Alice Springs.

items.title: Sir David Attenborough turns 100: Celebrate his life in his words
items.description: Natural history broadcaster Sir David Attenborough turns 100 today. We look back at his work and interviews to capture some of his wisdom and endless sense of wonder.

items.title: Wasp that eats host alive named after Attenborough for his 100th birthday
items.description: Taxonomists from London's Natural History Museum who named the Chilean species were inspired by the lifework of the famous broadcaster and naturalist.

items.title: Man arrested after allegedly threatening Andrew on dog walk
items.description: Police arrest a man who allegedly had a weapon and was threatening King Charles III's brother Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor near his Norfolk home on Wednesday evening, local time.

items.title: UK immigration officer guilty of spying on politicians for China
items.description: Two UK-Chinese nationals have been found guilty of spying for China, using UK police systems to gather information.

items.title: More hantavirus cases expected as passengers prepare to disembark ship
items.description: A number of countries are scrambling to trace people who disembarked from an Atlantic cruise struck by a deadly virus outbreak before it was marooned off the coast of Cabo Verde, in an effort to prevent further spread of the disease.

items.title: Ukraine launches major drone attack amid rows over Victory Day ceasefire
items.description: The Kremlin is taking extraordinary measures ahead of Russia's marking of the defeat of Nazi Germany, as Ukraine launches its second-biggest attack of the war so far.

items.title: ABC weekly news quiz: A stranded ship, an underwhelming space show and a Met movie moment
items.description: Don't bother looking up at the sky, it won't be worth it. Instead, try your luck testing your news knowledge from the past week.

items.title: Urzila Carlson thinks your mum is funny, and you should too
items.description: Urzila Carlson's start in comedy was an accident, but now the stand-up regular is bringing sketch comedy to our TV screens.

items.title: Bushfires now burn at a 'whole different level'. It means rethinking volunteers
items.description: Bushfires are occurring at a new level of ferocity across Australia. It could leave our volunteers overpowered.

items.title: Why this firebrand leader's defeat is hailed as a win for democracy in India
items.description: Mamata Banerjee was once considered a threat to India's Narendra Modi. But now, her historic defeat due to "misrule" has the Indian Opposition in tatters.

items.title: Hawthorn 'taught a bit of a lesson' after Fremantle's fourth-term blitz
items.description: Fremantle overcomes a 15-point deficit to beat Hawthorn thanks to a dominant final quarter.

items.title: Dogs coach says they're 'an easy target' for referees after fourth straight loss
items.description: The Dolphins recover from a rough start to hand the Bulldogs a fourth straight loss as coach Cameron Ciraldo bemoans decisions made by his players and the referees.

items.title: Ted Turner's infamous feud with Rupert Murdoch began in a Hobart boathouse
items.description: The two media moguls shared a bitter rivalry for decades after some drunken comments at a Hobart boathouse. Here's how their rivalry unfolded through the years.

items.title: UK police investigated over handling of Al-Fayed sexual offending allegations
items.description: The UK's Independent Office for Police Conduct says it is working to establish whether there were missed opportunities to stop Mohamed Al-Fayed as far back as 2008.

items.title: One answer to Australia's housing affordability crisis is hidden in plain sight
items.description: What if the sudden improvement in Iain's life, and the extra $600 a month in his pocket, can be traced back to a single policy decision made by a federal minister in the 1980s?

items.title: A tussle in Farrer, PM tries ACDC diplomacy
items.description: The heat is on in Farrer ahead of Saturday's by-election while in Canberra the prime minister has gone above and beyond with a gift for Japan's leader.

items.title: Kyle and Jackie O war costs ARN Media $26 million
items.description: ARN Media reveals "brand safety" concerns over the Kyle and Jackie O Show have cost the company tens of millions in advertising revenue.
